bear.probability_evidence: The reverse DCF shows the $84.41 price implies 28.7% year-1 revenue growth, well above what the note says DexCom is actually delivering per its 10-Q (research/DXCM/2026-10-09.md sec.3); gross margin has fallen 8.5pp over five years to 62.5% TTM (IS); and the pending G6/G7 and securities class-action litigation remains an unquantified tail risk (10-Q, note sec.2/6).
